calibration.derivation: wing_scale = 0.5 / (wing p95 * motor_pool_gain); jump_scale = 0.5 / (jump p95 * motor_pool_gain)

disclosure.note: the scales that would put each group's measured MAXIMUM pool magnitude exactly at the +-1 clip; recorded so the headroom this calibration leaves is auditable, not applied

jump.quantity: abs(pre-gain, pre-scale TTMn jump pool mean) = abs(fsum(weight * activity) / summed_abs_weight) over the two TTMn members, every measured tick

wing.quantity: abs(pre-gain, pre-scale pool mean) = abs(fsum(weight * activity) / summed_abs_weight), pooled over both wing-motor pools and every measured tick

encoder.note: binds this calibration to the exact engineered-encoder document (the eem v1 absolute encoder) and population membership it was measured under; every v1-schema calibration is refused by the escape loader and vice versa

jump_readout.formula: jump_raw = motor_pool_gain * (fsum(TTMn activity) / 2) * jump_scale; jump_value = clip(jump_raw, -1, 1), zeroed when |clip(jump_raw, -1, 1)| < motor_dead_zone; vertical_thrust = clip(vertical_projection + jump_value, -1, 1); forward, lateral, yaw, and pitch are untouched
jump_readout.note: binds this calibration to the exact TTMn pool membership and the declared jump mapping it was measured under

measured_under.note: the pre-calibration (readout_scale 1.0, jump_scale 1.0) controller identity the distributions below were measured with; the calibrated controller necessarily carries a different configuration and decoder identity

collision_derivation.note: the closest two-byte approximation of the declared Bernoulli p = 0.1; the exact executed probability is 6554/65536

stream.observation_derivation: rays (bytes 0:12) and light (byte 12, uniform 0..15) from sha256('full-readout-calibration-escape-v1:<tick>') bytes; horizontal/vertical collisions from bytes 13:15 / 15:17 as declared Bernoulli(6554/65536); deterministic, no PRNG
